lines_of_business: BCBSM and BCN joint policy; commercial HMO covered, criteria apply; BCNA Medicare Advantage see Government Regulations; may be used for MA where CMS rules not fully developed
effective_or_revised: Current policy effective 11/1/26; prior 11/1/25; next review 3rd Qtr 2027
criteria_location: Medical Policy Statement p.1 and Inclusionary and Exclusionary Guidelines p.2, six lines in total. Everything else is background. The score tables (CHA2DS2-VASc, HAS-BLED) are in the Background pp.3-4.
procedures_covered: FDA-approved percutaneous LAAC (Watchman, Watchman FLX, Amulet), 33340
Non-FDA devices (Lariat, Amplatzer Cardiac Plug) experimental

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Exclusions list: non-FDA devices; FDA devices in people not meeting the inclusion criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: increased risk of stroke and systemic embolism based on CHADS2 or CHA2DS2-VASc score and systemic anticoagulation therapy is recommended; AND The long term risks of systemic anticoagulation outweigh the risks of the device implantation.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: No cutoffs for either score; 'or' lets the submitter choose the score; 'outweigh' has no measure; the policy omits the 'contraindication' wording used by guidelines it cites.

requirement_kinds.quote: increased risk of stroke and systemic embolism based on CHADS2 or CHA2DS2-VASc score

vague_terms.problem: No threshold in criteria; score table is in Background.
Undefined; Background gives HAS-BLED >= 3 as 'high risk' but the criteria do not adopt it.

extraction_hazards: 33-page document, about 30 pages evidence review with study numbers (CHA2DS2-VASc means 4.7 etc.) that look like thresholds
Table 1 is titled CHADS2 and CHA2DS2-VASc but lists only CHA2DS2-VASc rows
Policy effective date 11/1/26 is after today's date; version history includes a row marked 'Added new E/I MPS; Added Exclusions'
Blue Care Network coverage page appended
interesting_structures: Inclusions/Exclusions format with an exclusion that restates the negation of the inclusion
Criteria so generic they delegate all numbers to the clinician

fit_to_tree.why: Structure is trivial (all of two plus device), but both leaves are judgement statements with no thresholds, so a checker would have to invent cutoffs.
